summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Homeland Group iteration 14 features: Updates feed, merged Insights carousel, navbar consolidation, theme customization, project visibility/reorder, and light-mode logo swap. All backend APIs and frontend UI components are working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: Admin authentication with env credentials
Backend: GET /api/updates returns published updates sorted by pinned then date desc
Backend: Admin CRUD on /api/admin/updates (create, list, update, delete)
Backend: Update link_type variants (none/project/external) persist correctly
Backend: GET /api/projects excludes projects with visible:false
Backend: Admin toggle visible on/off via PUT /api/admin/projects/:id
Backend: Project reorder via PUT updates to 'order' field persists
Backend: site_content.theme (fonts, colors) persists via PUT /api/admin/content
Backend: site_logo_light persists and returned by GET /api/content
Frontend: Navbar shows single 'Insights' item linking to /updates
Frontend: Navbar shows single 'Enquire Now' CTA (no Book Visit button)
Frontend: Home Insights carousel renders merged cards (updates + posts)
Frontend: Carousel play/pause toggle works (data-testid: insights-autoplay-toggle)
Frontend: Carousel prev/next navigation works
Frontend: Carousel pagination dots work
Frontend: Public /updates page renders with all filter tabs (All/Updates/News/Media/Blog)
Frontend: Filter tabs are clickable and functional
Frontend: Update cards render correctly
Frontend: Light-mode logo swaps to /homeland-logo-dark.webp when theme is light
Frontend: Admin login works with credentials from /app/api/.env
Frontend: Admin Updates page create button (admin-update-create) works
Frontend: Admin Updates create/save flow works
Frontend: Admin Updates quick toggles for published/pinned work
Frontend: Admin Projects table renders with all columns
Frontend: Admin Projects visibility toggle (admin-project-toggle-visible-*) works
Frontend: Admin Projects slider toggle (admin-project-toggle-slider-*) present
Frontend: Admin Projects move up/down buttons (admin-project-move-up/down-*) work
Frontend: Admin Content Appearance tab accessible
Frontend: Admin Content font selectors (display, body, scale) present and functional
Frontend: Admin Content color inputs (gold, bg_dark, bg_light) present with correct values
Frontend: Admin Content theme reset button present
Frontend: Admin Content save button present
